_comment: Default calibration of the merit-order / coupling model. Values are set by hand to reproduce typical 2023-2024 Swiss day-ahead patterns (level ~80 EUR/MWh, summer midday dip, winter evening peak). Run model/calibrate.py with an ENTSO-E token to re-fit them on real data; it overwrites this file and sets fitted=true.

meritOrder._comment: x = share of regional (DE/FR/IT/AT) demand that must be met by dispatchable thermal plants (negative = renewable surplus that must be exported, stored, absorbed by electrolysers or curtailed). Price points: kind floor -> mult*negFloor, abs -> EUR/MWh, ccgt/ocgt -> mult * short-run marginal cost

coupling._comment: regionalDemandGW: average demand of the coupled DE/FR/IT/AT region; swissPremium: structural CH spread vs. region; importSlope/exportSlope: EUR/MWh per GW beyond the net transfer capacity

hydro._comment: storage-hydro monthly release pattern (share of annual budget) and smoothing of the water-value dispatch
